message.content:
Below is a **ready‑to‑use “Paris Trip Planner”** you can copy into your calendar, share with friends, or print out as a handy reference while you’re abroad.  
Feel free to tweak dates, add personal preferences, or let me know what else you’d love to see—happy travels!  

---

## 📅 Quick Overview – 7 Days in Paris

| Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening |
|-----|---------|-----------|--------|
| **1** | Arrive & settle in | Orientation walk around neighborhood | Light dinner + Seine river cruise |
| **2** | Louvre Museum | Palais Royal / Jardin des Tuileries | Classic French cuisine at Le Comptoir du Relais |
| **3** | Eiffel Tower & Champ de Mars | Musée d’Orsay | Rooftop bar (Le Perchoir) |
| **4** | Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur | Moulin Rouge rehearsal tour | Cabaret show (optional) |
| **5** | Palace of Versailles | Gardens stroll | Dinner near Champs‑Élysées |
| **6** | Latin Quarter & Luxembourg Gardens | Notre-Dame & Sainte-Chapelle | Wine tasting at Ô Chateau |
| **7** | Shopping/Last‑minute sights | Departure prep | Fly home |

> *If you have more than a week, extend Day 5–6 over two days; otherwise compress it.*

---

### ✈️ Getting There

| Option | Notes |
|-------|------|
| **Direct Flight** from major hubs (NYC, London, Frankfurt, Dubai…) | ~8–10 hrs nonstop |
| **Connecting via hub** (Amsterdam, Madrid, Istanbul) | Often cheaper, longer total travel time |
| **Train** (Eurostar from London) | Scenic ride through the English Channel, arrive directly in Gare du Nord |

*Tip:* Book tickets 2–3 months ahead for the best fares. Check airlines’ baggage policies early—most allow 23 kg checked plus carry‑on.

---

## 🏨 Accommodation Choices

| Budget | Neighborhood | Highlights |
|--------|--------------|------------|
| €50–€80/night | **Montparnasse** | Near Metro Line 12, close to Parc Monceau |
| €90–€150/night | **Marais** | Trendy boutiques, historic streets, great cafés |
| €160+ /night | **Saint‑Germain‑en‑Laye** (just outside city) | Luxury hotels, spa access, quieter vibe |

**Booking Tips**

- Look for properties with free Wi-Fi and breakfast included.
- Verify proximity to metro stations (≤ 500 m).
- Read recent reviews about cleanliness and staff friendliness.

---

## 🚇 Transportation Inside Paris

| Mode | How It Works | Cost (per person) | Best For |
|------|-------------|-------------------|----------|
| **Metro/Subway** | 16 lines covering most attractions | €1.90 single ticket; €14.90 pass for 24h | Daily commutes |
| **RER B** | Connects airport → city center | Same fare as metro | Airport transfers |
| **Bus** | Redirection when metro closed | Same fare | Night routes, scenic views |
| **Bike Share (Vélib')** | Dockless bikes across city | €0.35 per minute + €1.40 daily fee | Short trips, exercise |
| **Taxi/Uber** | Metered rates | Starts €4.20 + €1.25/km | Late night, heavy luggage |

> *Purchase a Navigo Week Pass (€22.75) if staying ≥ 5 consecutive days—it covers unlimited rides on all public transport.*

---

## 🍽️ Food & Drink Must‑Dos

| Dish | Where to Try | Why |
|------|---------------|-----|
| Croissant & Café au lait | **Du Pain et des Idées**, Saint‑Ouen | Artisan bakery, buttery croissants |
| Escargot | **L’Arpège** (Michelin 3★) | Classic French delicacy |
| Crêpes | **Crêperie Bretonne**, Rue Mouffetard | Sweet & savory varieties |
| Cheese platter | **Fromagerie Barthélémy**, Marais | Wide selection of aged cheeses |
| Macarons | **Pierre Hermé**, multiple locations | World‑famous pastries |
| Champagne | **Champagne Barrière**, 9th arrondissement | Local tastings without leaving Paris |
| Street food | **Marché Bastille** | Fresh falafel, kebabs, crepe stands |

**Dining Etiquette**

- Keep hands visible on the table (no elbows).  
- Wait until everyone has been served before starting.  
- A small tip (~15%) is appreciated but not mandatory if service charge already applied.

---

## 🎭 Cultural Experiences

| Activity | Suggested Time | Ticket Info |
|----------|-----------------|-------------|
| **Seine River Cruise** | Early evening | €13–€30 depending on length |
| **Cabinet de Curiosités** | Midday | Free entry |
| **Opera Garnier Tour** | Afternoon | €11 online |
| **Nighttime City Lights Walk** | Sunset | Self-guided |
| **Wine & Dégustation** | Evenings | €45–€70 per group |

> *Book museum tickets online up to 60 days in advance to skip queues.*

---

## 🌍 Practicalities & Safety

| Topic | Key Points |
|-------|------------|
| Visa | Schengen short stay (< 90 days); check passport validity > 6 months. |
| Currency | Euro (€). Credit cards widely accepted; keep cash for markets. |
| Language | Basic French phrases help; many locals speak English. |
| Power Plug | Type C/E sockets, 230 V supply. Bring adapter. |
| Emergency Numbers | Police: 17, Ambulance: 15, Fire: 18. |
| Health Insurance | Travel insurance covering medical evacuation advisable. |
| Weather Forecast | May-June: mild (15–21°C), occasional showers. Pack light layers + umbrella. |

---

## ⛱️ Packing Checklist

| Category | Essentials |
|----------|------------|
| Clothing | Comfortable walking shoes, versatile outfits, jacket, hat |
| Electronics | Phone charger, power bank, universal plug adaptor |
| Documents | Passport, visas, copies of reservations, health card |
| Toiletries | Toothbrush, deodorant, minimal cosmetics |
| Miscellaneous | Reusable water bottle, notebook, sunglasses |

---

## 💡 Bonus Ideas (Optional)

| Interest | Suggestion |
|----------|------------|
| Art lover | Visit Centre Pompidou, Fondation Louis Vuitton |
| History buff | Explore Île de la Cité, Conciergerie |
| Nature fan | Picnic at Parc des Buttes Chaumont |
| Shopaholic | Galeries Lafayette, Printemps Haussmann |
| Off‑beat | Canal Saint-Martin bike ride, street art tours in Belleville |

---

### Final Thought

Your Paris adventure will blend iconic landmarks with hidden gems, gourmet delights with everyday charm. With this planner in hand, you’ll navigate the city confidently and make memories that last forever. Bon voyage! 🇫🇷✈️
